'''Martin Falke Operative Manipulator''' is a [[Dark]] constructed list published on Decipher Deck Designs.

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[Martin Falke]]
* '''Published:''' September 1999 (Decipher Deck Designs)
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Endor]]
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Imperial Occupation / Imperial Control|SE-D-imperialoccupation.gif|label=Imperial Occupation}}
* '''Strategy:''' Operative Manipulator
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:PEndor Operative Manipulator Falke DS.txt |Download]]
